headline: 30–60s videos deliver a 7.19× median view/follower lift — the single biggest lever in protein coffee.
moves: Shoot your next protein coffee video between 30–60 seconds: that format has a 7.19× lift (n=24) and makes up 59% of the top quartile vs 9% of the bottom.
Write a long caption (4.17× lift, n=35) and add 5+ hashtags (2.06× lift, n=21) — long captions appear in 59% of top-quartile videos vs 23% of bottom, and 5+ hashtags in 27% of top vs 5% of bottom.
Use licensed music (5.74× lift, n=7) and layer text-heavy on-screen elements (3.37× lift, n=59) with a text hook in the first 3 seconds (2.11× lift, n=72).
avoid: Stop posting 60s+ videos — they have a 0.16× lift (n=46), and original audio is even worse at 0.17× (n=82).
hooks: This protein coffee has been cold-brewed for 20 hours — here's why that changes everything.
When I started my fitness journey, I thought protein coffee had to taste like chalk.
One thing about me: I love a little 3pm protein coffee that actually keeps me full.
